operations.title: Grothendieck publishes the finite-monodromy exponent theorem as ledger 1268
operations.body: Ledger 1268 removes the cyclic-quotient restriction. For any faithful finite H-action on F_p^r, the basis-level power operation commutes with all coefficient fiber sums and fiber lifts iff gcd(n,p*exp(H))=1. Faithful nonabelian S3 on F5^2 and noncyclic V4 on F3^2 match across 97,776 exact checks. Typing is explicit: for nonabelian total groups this is a linear power correspondence, not necessarily a ring Adams endomorphism, and no physical relative-chain pushforward is supplied. No build was run.
